clips.title: The story
paras: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered relic bearing the regal mark of the fallen northern kingdom. Found amidst the desolate ruins of Capital City, such relics are scarce since the kingdom's fall, and someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this one.

When the Scourge tore through the kingdom of Lordaeron, its palaces, archives, and proud insignias were largely obliterated or left to decay under the shadow of the Undercity. Surviving physical artifacts bearing the royal crest are exceedingly rare. Recovering an intact or weathered crest from the northern ruins represents a tangible piece of human history rescued from oblivion.

Following the Third War, thousands of northern refugees fled south toward the Kingdom of Stormwind, carrying only memories of their homeland. In Stormwind City, Lady Dena Kennedy is keen to acquire such remnants of Lordaeron, making relics like this crest deeply cherished in the southern capital.
